annotations.text:
Fully clickable: pick a treatment, a doctor, a day and a slot, then send the OTP and confirm. The Continue button stays dead until each step is genuinely complete — that is the real validation rule, not decoration.

Everything in [square brackets] is a placeholder for you to fill: clinic name, address, phone, doctor names, prices, review counts.

The blue is an approximation of the Dentalkart brand, not a sampled value — the live site was unreachable when this was built. PALETTE.md in the repo maps every hex to its role so swapping it is one pass.

Entity names here match your existing lms1-backend Prisma schema — Appointment, InventoryItem, InventoryTransaction, Supplier, Invoice, Payment, StaffProfile, StaffSchedule — so these screens sit on the API you already have rather than needing a new one.

The inventory card is the Dentalkart integration: click Approve and place order to watch the loop close.

The medico-legal gate is real: the Sign button is disabled until you tick the responsibility checkbox. Nothing reaches the patient before a doctor signs. Do not let anyone talk you into removing that step — it is what keeps the voice feature on the right side of NMC rules.

Open the tweak chips above this artboard to set your real monthly patient volume and your loaded hourly cost — the whole savings table recomputes from your numbers, not mine. Switch a loop off to see what it was carrying.
